data.name: Haneena
data.gender_notes: Haneena is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-n-n' meaning 'to be gracious, kind, or beautiful'. In Islamic tradition, Haneena represents the embodiment of elegance and loveliness. The name Haneena carries the meaning “Graceful, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haneena usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a girl with a beautiful soul, radiating inner and outer beauty
data.etymology: Haneena belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, Beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haneena total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: حنانة
in_arabic.long_meaning: حُنَانَةٌ من أَصَولِ اللّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ، وَيُعْنَى بِاللُّّونِ وَالْمُحَابَّةِ وَالرَّقَّةِ. لا يوجد ذكرٌ لِكلمةِ حَنانَةٌ في القُرآنِ الكريمِ، وَلَكِنْ أَصْلُها يُفْسِرُ بِالْحُننِ وَالْوَدِّ وَالْمَحَابَّةِ، وَتَجِدُ هذهِ الْقِيَمُ مُؤَدَّاةً فِي الإسلامِ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ.

in_urdu.name: حُنّا
in_urdu.long_meaning: حُنّا ایک عربی اصطلاح ہے جس کے معنی محبت، نرمی، شفقت اور دلنشینی کے ہیں۔ یہ نام اسلامی تہذیب میں رُقّت اور مہربانی کی علامت ہے۔ یہ نام قرآن میں موجود نہیں ہے لیکن اس کے لغوی معنی محبت اور شفقت سے جڑے ہوئے ہیں۔ یہ نام مسلمانوں میں خاص طور پر عورتوں کے نام کے طور پر مشہور ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हनीना
in_hindi.long_meaning: हनीना एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ प्यार, स्नेह, दया और करुणा होता है। यह नाम इस्लाम में रहमानियत और प्रेम की प्रतीक है। यह नाम कुरान में नहीं है, लेकिन इसके मूल में प्रेम और दया के अर्थ हैं। यह नाम मुस्लिम समुदाय में विशेष रूप से लड़कियों के लिए एक लोकप्रिय नाम है।

in_pashto.name: هېنا
in_pashto.long_meaning: هېنا یو پښتو نوم دی چې په عربي ژبه کې هم ورسته شته. په عربي کې د وړتوب، محبت او رحمت معنا لري. په اسلامي تمدن کې د مهرباني او محبت له معناي يې د وړتوب لپاره یوه شمېر نښه وړ ده.

in_english.name: Haneena
in_english.long_meaning: Haneena is an Arabic name meaning 'tenderness, affection, kindness, and compassion'. While not explicitly mentioned in the Quran, its root evokes these Islamic values of love, empathy, and gentleness. Haneena is a popular name in Muslim cultures, symbolizing nurturing and warmth.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: هېنا [heena]

data.cultural_impact: The name Haneena is a beautiful and elegant choice for a girl in Islamic cultures. It holds significance in that it signifies the inherent gentleness, gracefulness, and beauty present in all women. Haneena's name is reminiscent of the delicate and refined nature that is held dear in Islamic societies, resonating with the values of femininity and gentleness.
data.spiritual_significance: Haneena as a spiritual name carries the potential to inspire a deep sense of kindness, love, and compassion. The name itself embodies the nature of the Divine, who is described in Islamic tradition as ar-Rahman, the Most Gracious and ar-Rahim, the Most Merciful. Thus, carrying the name Haneena serves as a constant reminder for the importance of extending grace, kindness, and love to others, reflecting the loving and compassionate nature of the Divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Haneena means "pleasing to look at" or "beautiful to behold" in Arabic. This name embodies the inner and outer beauty that a person possesses, inspiring admiration and attraction. Its symbolic meaning encourages one to strive for personal growth and self-improvement, reflecting the belief that beauty is a manifestation of the divine.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah Wa Al-Nihayah, Volume 3, Page 225-226. The name Haneena carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Description of Banu Asad ibn Al-Khuzraji and mention of Haneen bint Jaabir ibn Abdul-Muttalib as one of their chieftains.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Abdul-Hadee in Al-Muu'jam Al-Kabeer, Volume 1, Page 78. The name Haneena carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mention of Haneen bint Al-Hasan as a poetess.
